name: webharvester
description: Chromium extension permission reference generated from Chromium sources and live browser measurement. Standalone, or automatic with Growser (growser.org) — the default browser of the webharvester tool — via --enable-webharvester.

plugins.name: web-harvester
plugins.description: Let Claude Code act autonomously on the live web through the user's own real, logged-in browser (Growser): screenshots, data between tabs, actions on the user's behalf, timed checks — carrying a task through end to end. Ships the web-discover capability reference.
